title.zh: 【Sui 上线 Circle CCTP V2，原生 USDC 可与 29 条链互转】
title.en: 【Sui 上线 Circle CCTP V2，原生 USDC 可与 29 条链互转】

current_state.zh: Sui has integrated Circle's CCTP V2, enabling native USDC issued directly by Circle to be transferred between Sui and 29 other supported chains.
current_state.en: Sui has integrated Circle's CCTP V2, enabling native USDC issued directly by Circle to be transferred between Sui and 29 other supported chains.
